story: A breakaway of four riders formed after 15 km, including Zamperini, Schwarzbacher, Hayter, and Thierry. Hayter dropped out due to mechanical issues. The remaining three stayed ahead for most of the race but were caught in the last 5 km. Olav Kooij won the sprint, overtaking Mads Pedersen for victory.
